entities.summary: Diamond Rock is a 175-meter-high (574-foot) basalt island located south of "Grande Anse du Diamant" before arriving from the south at Fort-de-France, the main port of the Caribbean island of Martinique. The uninhabited island is about 2 kilometres from Pointe Diamant and its area is 5.3 ha.
